description: Snow/Ice Sidewalk Ordinance Violations (HISTORICAL) is a dataset listed in City of Cambridge open data portal (data.cambridgema.gov), an open data portal (Socrata) of a city, published or maintained by City of Cambridge. Unshoveled/Icy Sidewalk Violations Since 12/1/2007. Coverage: Cambridge, Massachusetts. The portal files it under the category Public Works. Its tags are vision zero, health and safety, snow and ice, violations, glocal. The table has 13 columns. Attribution on the portal: Public Works. The portal shows 2019-05-16 as the last data update. It is reached through the links recorded on this page, with the catalogue entry as the discovery route. Access is free of charge and open. The licence is Open Data Commons Public Domain Dedication and License. Caveats: this record was written from the catalogue listing only, so the linked page was not opened, its contents and current availability were not checked, and the description may lag the source. It can support cycling and walking network and demand studies. Related record: the catalogue-level record data-soc-data-cambridgema-gov-portal.
